en: Because the human arm is a third-class lever, your bicep must pull with much more force than the actual weight of the object you lift.
A shark's skin has tiny tooth-like scales called denticles that reduce fluid friction, allowing it to swim through the ocean much faster and quieter.
Even though gravity is a very weak force, a tiny refrigerator magnet can easily overcome the entire Earth's gravitational pull to hold up a paperclip.
The Earth's geographic North Pole is actually a magnetic south pole, which is why the north-seeking end of a compass needle is attracted to it.
A single bolt of lightning can heat the surrounding air to 30,000 degrees Celsius, making it five times hotter than the visible surface of the Sun.
Light from the Sun takes about eight minutes to reach Earth, meaning we always see our star exactly as it looked eight minutes ago.
Sound travels more than four times faster in water than in air, allowing whales to communicate their songs across hundreds of miles of ocean.
Water is one of the very few substances that expands when it freezes into ice, which is why ice cubes float in your glass of water.
The chemical potential energy in an apple transforms into kinetic energy when you run and thermal energy to keep your body comfortably warm.
The zigzag path of a mountain road acts as a giant inclined plane, greatly reducing the engine force needed for a truck to climb uphill.
An electromagnet only works when electric current flows through its coils, allowing junkyard cranes to drop heavy scrap metal by simply turning off the switch.
A thermos flask uses an empty vacuum layer between its walls to stop heat conduction, keeping hot soup hot and cold juice cold.
